overview.en:
Search BioRender templates and accessible figures, preview results, and create editable scientific figure drafts through BioRender's official hosted MCP server.

Find scientific visual references and prepare editable illustration drafts. Start with the mechanism or experimental process and label each visual relationship clearly.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
搜索科学绘图模板与已有图稿，预览并创建可编辑的科学插图草稿。

查找科学绘图参考并准备可编辑插图草稿，从机制或实验流程出发，清晰标注各项视觉关系。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Find templates for illustrating a cell-signaling pathway.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查找适合绘制细胞信号通路的模板。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare an editable draft explaining this experimental workflow.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备解释这个实验流程的可编辑图稿草稿。

starterPrompts.en: Review the available illustrations for this mechanism and compare them.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看适用于这个机制的可用图稿，并进行比较。
